english.title: Remain unlawfully at large after recall to prison - Crime (Sentences) Act 1997
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been recalled to **(..SPECIFY PRISON..) under section 32 of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997 on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF RECALL..) and notified of the recall

(A)_[orally,]_
(B)_[in writing,]_
(C)_[orally and in writing]_

failed, without reasonable excuse, while unlawfully at large, to take all necessary steps to return to prison as soon as possible
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32ZA of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
recalled to prison under s32
notified of recall orally / in writing
failed without reasonable excuse
while unlawfully at large
to take all necessary steps to return to prison as soon as possible

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A person is to be treated as having been notified of the recall if written notice of the recall has been delivered to an appropriate address and a period specified in the notice has elapsed.
(ii) A person is also to be treated as having been notified of the recall if -
(a) the person's licence requires the person to keep in touch in accordance with any instructions given by an officer of a provider of probation services,
(b) the person has failed to comply with such an instruction, and (c) the person has not complied with such an instruction for at least 6 months.

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 32ZA(5)(b) and (6) of the Crime (Sentences) Act 1997 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
